commits.notes: C01 specification and metadata validator verified locally; this does not certify workflow engine execution.
C02 reproducible toolchain resources and metadata validator verified locally; this does not certify workflow engine execution.
C03 unified engine setup and supervisor launch verified locally; domain processing remains pending.
C04 typed domain input and result contracts verified locally; persistence remains pending.
Bounded local metadata port and recovery proof verified; identity, provider permission and plaintext enforcement remain C08-C15 work.
Engine runtime CI verification, test discovery inventory, and negative recovery bounds verified from a clean checkout; provider adapters begin in C07.
OpenBao capability adapter, dev-mode refusal in production, and scoped workload identity verified; OIDC authenticated session context begins in C08.
OIDC identity provider integration, claim/nonce/PKCE validation, and scoped owner authorization verified; session establishment begins in C09.
Short-lived bound sessions, immediate revocation preventing reveal, secure cookies (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict), and token log redaction verified.
Fresh step-up reauthentication for sensitive actions (reveal and policy change), 120s TTL expiry, session binding enforcement, and token redaction verified.
Server-side path manipulation cannot widen effective provider permissions; segment-boundary matching, canonical path normalization, and forged header defenses verified.
User sees no unauthorized secret names or existence via errors; vault metadata filtered and single-item lookups masked.
CAS version prevents lost update; bytes never enter metadata storage; provider-owned DEK envelopes verified.
Bounded authorized reveal with provider-owned sealed payload (OpenBao KV v2), mandatory fresh step-up, no-store response and secret-free errors, traces and audit content verified locally.

Blocking of plaintext persistence paths across logs, DB metadata, traces, disk files, and browser storage verified locally with sentinel canary detection, cycle/degree bounds, and deterministic reordered serialization.
Attributable metadata audit events adhering to the CloudEvents 1.0 profile verified locally with actor, action, and outcome preserved, and zero secret or bearer credential leakage.
Least privilege provider grants verified locally with mandatory step-up for member changes and immediate privilege reduction taking effect on next sensitive request.
Resumable provider version and KEK rotations verified locally; partial rotation resumes from durable checkpoint without deleting valid prior secret version.
Provider retention and explicit destruction verified locally; delete and destroy are distinct, irreversible version destruction requires explicit operator action.
Authorized metadata console rendered; UI never fetches plaintext merely to render a secret list (Requirement F14).
Transient reveal interaction implemented; plaintext clears from rendered state on close and logout, cache and service worker exclude reveal routes (Requirement F15).
Access governance and rotation console rendered; partial and failed provider operations are visible and cannot look like success (Requirement F16).
Provider health surveillance and outage resilience implemented; no plaintext fallback exists during outage, strict audited reveal policy enforced (Requirement F17).
Provider root custody and an isolated restore drill verified with synthetic fixtures; live OpenBao/Keycloak restore and clean-host restore remain C30 work.

Separately stored audit checkpoint verification implemented and verified with synthetic Ed25519 fixtures; explicit TrustPolicy, explicit VerificationStatus including UNAVAILABLE, and monotonic sequence authority tracking enforced (Requirement F19).

Security matrix passed with synthetic secrets before any personal production credentials enter provider; immediate privilege revocation, mandatory step-up, zero plaintext leakage across all sinks, and restart durability verified (Requirement F20).

Verified project abuse and authorization boundaries across browser and engine surfaces (Requirement N27). Prototype pollution, JSON complexity/depth limits, XSS sanitization, zero telemetry, cross-tenant isolation, step-up bypass rejection, revoked grant denial, path traversal rejection, tampered ciphertext AEAD rejection, and provider outage fail-closed handling all passed with zero critical or high findings.

Verified bounded target and overload workloads on local profile (Requirement N28). Benchmarked target 5-user workload (p50: 6.1ms, p95: 14.16ms, p99: 18.64ms), confirmed overload rejection on oversized payloads and metadata with zero resource leaks, clean cancellation handling, engine restart durability, and verified provider-owned secret byte invariant under race detector.

Separated web health from engine, authoritative storage and required provider readiness (Requirement N29). Exposed real engine readiness and composite diagnostics partitioning web, engine, storage, and provider components, proved fail-closed visibility on provider outage/sealed state and audit degradation, and verified bounded diagnostic logs with zero canary sentinel leakage under race detector.

Verified full local usability from git clone on clean supported Linux host (Requirement N30). Real engine readiness, owner sign-in, scoped write, step-up reveal, transient clear, member grant creation, member revocation denial, restart persistence, zero plaintext at rest, provider outage fail-closed, and OpenBao snapshot restore with durable grant revocation all passed.
